title: Majority Influence Depends on Coalition Size
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $A,B\\subseteq\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$ be sets of coordinates with $|A|=|B|$. On the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, define majority to be $+1$ when the sum of the coordinates is nonnegative and $-1$ otherwise. For either target sign $b\\in\\{-1,1\\}$, the coalitional influence of majority toward $b$ is the same for $A$ and $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ and $B$ are sets of coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$
